query:
SELECT 
  id,
  status,
  contractAccepted,
  contractAcceptedAt,
  contractAcceptedIp,
  contractVersion,
  contractPdfUrl,
  renterId,
  hostId,
  vehicleId,
  totalPrice,
  createdAt
FROM bookings
WHERE status IN ('confirmed', 'in_progress', 'completed')
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
